test_title: PYST 86: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
If 'M × N' means 'M is the father of N'.

If 'M + N' means 'M is the wife of N'.

If 'M ÷ N' means 'M is the son of N'.

If ‘M - N' means 'M is the husband of N'.

How is W related to T in the expression 'T ÷ V + W × U'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Husband
 Father
 Son 
 
 

 

Given: T ÷ V + W × U

It means: T is the son of V, V is the wife of W and W is the father of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91bcf133aa8c4fbac82305a9799c3f252454316bf28f649f97662eaf6866bc01.png] 

So, W is the '**Father**' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father".
